requirements.title: Local track minimum
requirements.summary: Complete 9 credit hours for this BS track/specialization. Semester unit is independently verified by SMU credit-hour policy.

requirements.title: Required AI/ML courses
requirements.summary: Complete both courses. Publisher IDs are matched to course identities independently verified in the rendered program page and linked course records.

requirements.title: Advisor-approved track elective
requirements.summary: Complete 3 credit hours of track electives approved by the advisor. The source states an approval criterion rather than a finite elective pool.

requirements.title: Host-degree technical elective separation
requirements.summary: Track courses cannot also satisfy the separate host-degree technical electives.

requirements.title: Credit-unit definition
requirements.summary: SMU defines its program credit hours as semester credit hours.

requirements.title: Relationship to host degree
requirements.summary: The specialization appears on the transcript but not diploma. It cannot be awarded outside its associated major; multiple specializations within one major may not share courses.

requirements.title: Declaration and advising
requirements.summary: Meet the assigned advisor before enrollment. Qualify for and declare the host major by 75 total credits, including examination and transfer credits. Program changes must be approved and processed through the current school records office.

requirements.title: University and school residency relationship
requirements.summary: University baseline residency is 60 SMU credits after a two-year institution or 48 after a four-year institution; when there was no prior full-time enrollment, the greater transferred-credit source determines the category. SMU-campus, online, Taos, approved Abroad and departmental-examination/audition/portfolio credit qualify. Lyle publishes its own more restrictive school requirements, mapped separately. These are host-degree conditions, not an invented nine-credit track residency rule.

requirements.title: Admission to the host Computer Science major
requirements.summary: Interschool admission needs 24 completed credits, cumulative GPA at least 2.000, the CS subset GPA at least 2.500 and C- or better in each subset course. Published subset: WRTR 1312/WRTR 2303/WRTR 2305, WRTR 1313/WRTR 2304/WRTR 2306 or equivalent, MATH 1337, MATH 1338, CS 1341, CS 1342. Approval is by the department chair and undergraduate advising/records director. Transfer entrants must meet equivalent requirements.

requirements.title: Subset GPA and repeated work
requirements.summary: CS subset GPA includes all attempts except authorized grade-replacement repeats. AP/IB holders use the remaining graded subset courses; properly forgiven old academic work is excluded. The university repeat policy is mapped separately.

requirements.title: School completion grades
requirements.summary: Each prescribed course requires a passing grade. Overall all-college, SMU-attempted degree-work and major-field GPAs must each be at least 2.000. Coursework counted toward the major cannot be pass/fail. Course-specific prerequisites can require C- or better even where the school completion threshold is a passing grade.

requirements.title: Lyle host-degree residency
requirements.summary: Earn 60 credits as SMU credit, including 30 in the major department or interdisciplinary program. Of the final 60 degree credits, 45 must be in courses offered by Lyle faculty; only unusual cases may receive a faculty exception. These host-degree totals are not additional track credits.

requirements.title: Catalog choice and declaration
requirements.summary: Major requirements follow the matriculation academic year or a subsequent year. Official declaration or changes go through Lyle Undergraduate Advising and Student Records.

requirements.title: School transfer approval
requirements.summary: Lyle accepts transfer work with identifiable curricular counterparts and C- or better from regionally or comparably accredited institutions. Acceptance and equivalency are reviewed, not automatic; school residency limits still apply.

requirements.title: Pass/fail and program requirements
requirements.summary: Voluntary pass/fail generally excludes major/minor requirements; school policy controls any exception. Lyle explicitly prohibits pass/fail for coursework counted toward the major, including the associated track/specialization.

requirements.title: Grade-replacement repeats
requirements.summary: For courses from Fall 2017 onward, up to six SMU courses with D+ or lower may be repeated once at SMU under grade replacement; the later grade counts even if lower. The same course is required except permitted writing/critical-reasoning foundation substitutions. A prerequisite cannot be repeated after its dependent course has been satisfactorily completed. Withdrawn repeats do not consume the limit; former first-year repeats do. Only repeated-course hours count toward graduation; both grades remain on the record and original standing actions remain.

requirements.title: Other Lyle repeats
requirements.summary: Outside grade replacement, Lyle permits one repeat when the original grade is C- or lower. Both grades enter GPA and standing calculations; only the repeated-course hours count for graduation. The prerequisite-after-dependent-course prohibition still applies.

requirements.title: Pre-matriculation transfer review
requirements.summary: Pre-matriculation college work, including work during high school, may receive credit under university transfer-admission criteria; credit can be denied for educational reasons. Lyle equivalency and grade criteria apply.

requirements.title: Post-matriculation transfer limits
requirements.summary: After SMU matriculation, at most 30 credits may transfer from accredited four-year institutions; work at institutions principally awarding associate/BAS degrees is ineligible. Students designate applicable courses with academic services. Seek domestic preapproval to establish transferability; permission may still be denied for educational reasons. Without prior approval, a later petition has no guarantee of credit.

requirements.title: International and study-away approval
requirements.summary: US citizens need Education Abroad Council approval for non-SMU study outside the US, including remote instruction. Non-affiliated abroad programs require a petition by October 1 of the preceding academic year plus normal study-abroad application approval. Approved SMU Abroad courses are SMU coursework. F-1/J-1 students taking courses in their home country (EU treated as one home area) need each course approved before enrollment, current English syllabus documentation and a final official transcript; the 30-credit limit remains.

requirements.title: Foreign transcript evaluation
requirements.summary: International transcripts require an official English record/translation, course information and evaluation by an SMU-accepted agency. An external evaluation recommends equivalence; SMU makes the credit decision.

notes: Reviewed complete within the local nine-credit BS specialization scope: CS 5320, CS 5324 and three advisor-approved elective credits, with applicable declaration, admission, overlap, grading, repeat, transfer and residency policies. This audit does not certify the entire host Computer Science degree.

Both BA and BS rendered requirement sections were independently inspected in Chrome. Numeric publisher entries 0046401 and 0268171 resolve through visible course buttons and View details links to the registered course records; no hidden API was used.

The advisor-approved elective is an open approval rule, not an unavailable finite list. Separate host-degree technical electives cannot double count these track/specialization courses. Multiple tracks or specializations within the same major also cannot share courses.

The BA track appears on neither transcript nor diploma; the BS specialization appears on the transcript but not diploma. Both are part of their associated host major and cannot be awarded independently.

The university residency baseline and the more restrictive Lyle 60/30/45-credit conditions are preserved as host-degree policies, not additional local-track credits. School course-passing requirements do not erase the C- prerequisites on CS 5320 and CS 5324.
Policy tabs were reviewed through ordinary rendered catalog navigation and parsed only from the current published page widgets. Draft temporaryContent is not evidence.

Course descriptions, prerequisite statements and three semester-credit hours per required course are verified. Public course sites, example syllabi and concentration-specific learning outcomes remain unverified. First-offered date remains null.

2026-10-11 bounded evidence review: the public Lyle computer-science overview and existing local catalog/course observations provide no newly verified track-specific launch date, learning-outcome list, public course site or term-identified syllabus. Broad CS degree marketing and career-dashboard links are not assigned to this local AI track/specialization. Both required-course descriptions, prerequisites and semester-credit amounts were already populated; remaining links and dates stay unknown.
